QuestInfo.name: Aura's Origin 2
QuestInfo.0: The aura's source wasn't among the Oda infantry. It's got to be close...
QuestInfo.1: Only a commander could produce an aura this powerful. Charge deep into the enemy's base, Momijigahara 2 and find it!
QuestInfo.2: As expected, a commander was the source of the aura. He clutched a familiar white foxtail...
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 373 Can proceed to the Foxtail Mystery quest

0.0: It seemed unlikely that lowly soldiers would be entrusted with such energy. If anyone in Oda's army possesses this aura, it'll be a high-ranking officer.
0.1: You must make your way farther into the enemy camp. Try hunting down some warriors in Momijigahara 2.
